```{r}
# Functions for descriptive tables ----------------------------------------

# Format continuous variables as mean (SD), median (IQR), and range.
my.render.cont <- function(x) {
  with(
    stats.apply.rounding(stats.default(x, ), digits = 3),
    c(
      "",
      "Mean (SD)" = sprintf("%s (&plusmn; %s)", MEAN, SD),
      "Median (IQR)" = sprintf("%s (%s - %s)", MEDIAN, Q1, Q3),
      "Range" = sprintf("%s - %s", MIN, MAX)
    )
  )
}

# Format categorical variables as counts and percentages.
my.render.cat <- function(x) {
  c(
    "",
    sapply(
      stats.default(x),
      function(y) with(y, sprintf("%d (%0.0f%%)", FREQ, PCT))
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Number of comorbidities -------------------------------------------------

# Convert comorbidity indicators to integer values for summation.
data_final_wide <- data_final_wide %>%
  mutate(across(
    c(
      sleep_apneu,
      nasal_polyps,
      chron_rs,
      allerg_rhinocon,
      atopic_derm,
      vocal_chord,
      hyperventilation,
      depr,
      gerd,
      freq_infec
    ),
    ~ as.integer(as.character(.))
  ))

# Calculate the number of recorded comorbidities for each participant.
# Note: the variables included here follow the original analysis code.
data_final_wide <- data_final_wide %>%
  mutate(
    comor_n = rowSums(
      dplyr::select(
        .,
        sleep_apneu,
        nasal_polyps,
        chron_rs,
        allerg_rhinocon,
        atopic_derm,
        vocal_chord,
        hyperventilation,
        depr,
        gerd,
        freq_infec
      ),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )

# Inspect the distribution of comorbidity counts
hist(data_final_wide$comor_n, breaks = 50)

# Summarise the number of comorbidities by randomised group
table1_comor <- table1(
  ~ comor_n | arm,
  overall = c(left = "Total"),
  data = data_final_wide,
  render.continuous = my.render.cont,
  render.categorical = my.render.cat
)

table1_comor
```

# Work productivity and activity impairment (WPAI)

```{r}
# Work Productivity and Activity Impairment (WPAI) ------------------------

# Number of participants reporting paid work at baseline, overall and
# stratified by randomised group.
table(data_final_wide$H12paid_work_t0)
table(data_final_wide$H12paid_work_t0, data_final_wide$arm)


# Restrict WPAI calculations to participants reporting paid work.
# Retain the randomised group and the H12 questionnaire variables.
data_working <- subset(data_final_wide, H12paid_work_t0 == "Ja")

data_working <- data_working %>%
  select(patid, arm, starts_with("H12"))


# Convert questionnaire variables used in the calculations to numeric.
vars_to_numeric <- c(
  "H12hours_work_t0",
  "H12hours_absence_asthma_t0",
  "H12hours_absence_other_t0",
  "H12actual_working_hours_t0",
  "H12asthma_productivity_work_t0",
  "H12asthma_productivity_other_t0"
)

for (v in vars_to_numeric) {
  data_working[[v]] <- as.numeric(data_working[[v]])
}


# Cap reported actual working hours at the number of hours the participant
# was scheduled to work, to avoid actual hours exceeding scheduled hours.
data_working$H12actual_working_hours_t0 <- ifelse(
  data_working$H12actual_working_hours_t0 >
    data_working$H12hours_work_t0,
  data_working$H12hours_work_t0,
  data_working$H12actual_working_hours_t0
)


# Calculate working hours after absence ----------------------------------

# Scheduled hours minus hours missed due to asthma or other reasons.
data_working$actual_workingh_t0_computed <-
  data_working$H12hours_work_t0 -
  (
    data_working$H12hours_absence_asthma_t0 +
      data_working$H12hours_absence_other_t0
  )

# Set negative calculated working hours to zero.
data_working$actual_workingh_t0_computed <- ifelse(
  data_working$actual_workingh_t0_computed < 0,
  0,
  data_working$actual_workingh_t0_computed
)


# Absenteeism -------------------------------------------------------------

# Percentage of scheduled work hours missed due to asthma.
# Formula: hours missed due to asthma / scheduled work hours.
data_working$absent <- with(
  data_working,
  H12hours_absence_asthma_t0 / H12hours_work_t0
)

data_working$absent_perc <- data_working$absent * 100


# Presenteeism ------------------------------------------------------------

# Self-reported impairment while working due to asthma, on a 0-10 scale,
# rescaled to a proportion.
data_working$present <- with(
  data_working,
  H12asthma_productivity_work_t0 / 10
)

# Replace missing presenteeism values with zero, following the original
# analysis approach.
data_working <- data_working %>%
  mutate(
    present_computed = ifelse(is.na(present), 0, present)
  )

# Set presenteeism to zero when no working hours remain after absences.
data_working <- data_working %>%
  mutate(
    present_computed = ifelse(
      actual_workingh_t0_computed == 0,
      0,
      present_computed
    )
  )

data_working$present_computed_perc <- data_working$present_computed * 100


# Overall work impairment -------------------------------------------------

# Combine absenteeism and presenteeism into overall work impairment.
# Formula: absenteeism + (1 - absenteeism) * presenteeism.
data_working <- data_working %>%
  mutate(
    overall_work_impairment_perc =
      (absent + ((1 - absent) * present_computed)) * 100
  )


# Activity impairment -----------------------------------------------------

# Self-reported impairment in activities outside work due to asthma,
# rescaled from a 0-10 scale to a percentage.
data_working$activity_impairment_perc <- with(
  data_working,
  (H12asthma_productivity_other_t0 / 10) * 100
)


# Summarise WPAI outcomes by randomised group -----------------------------

table_wpai <- table1(
  ~ absent_perc +
    present_computed_perc +
    overall_work_impairment_perc +
    activity_impairment_perc | arm,
  overall = c(left = "Total"),
  data = data_working,
  render.continuous = my.render.cont,
  render.categorical = my.render.cat
)

table_wpai

# Inspect the distribution of overall work impairment
hist(data_working$overall_work_impairment_perc, breaks = 20)


# Summarise presenteeism among participants with a value above zero --------

present <- subset(data_working, present_computed_perc > 0)

# Number of participants with presenteeism, by randomised group
table(present$arm)

# Overall distribution
summary(present$present_computed_perc)

# Control group (arm = 0)
present_ct <- subset(present, arm == 0)
summary(present_ct$present_computed_perc)

# Intervention group (arm = 1)
present_iv <- subset(present, arm == 1)
summary(present_iv$present_computed_perc)
```



# Hospital Anxiety and Depression Scale (HADS)

```{r}
# Hospital Anxiety and Depression Scale (HADS) ----------------------------
# Extract HADS items, randomised group, and participant identifier.
# The participant identifier is used only for internal data handling and
# should not be included in any publicly shared participant-level output.

data_HADS <- select(
  data_final_wide,
  c("patid", "arm", starts_with("HADS"))
)


# Recode HADS item responses to numerical scores --------------------------
# HADS-A consists of the odd-numbered items; HADS-D consists of the
# even-numbered items. The response mappings below follow the original
# analysis code.

# HADS-A item 1
data_HADS <- data_HADS %>%
  mutate(
    HADS1_t0_num = case_when(
      HADS1_t0 == "Meestal" ~ 3,
      HADS1_t0 == "Vaak" ~ 2,
      HADS1_t0 == "Af en toe, soms" ~ 1,
      HADS1_t0 == "Helemaal niet" ~ 0
    ),
    .after = HADS1_t0
  )

# HADS-D item 2
data_HADS <- data_HADS %>%
  mutate(
    HADS2_t0_num = case_when(
      HADS2_t0 == "zeker zo veel" ~ 0,
      HADS2_t0 == "wat minder" ~ 1,
      HADS2_t0 == "duidelijk minder" ~ 2,
      HADS2_t0 == "nauwelijks nog" ~ 3
    ),
    .after = HADS2_t0
  )

# HADS-A item 3
data_HADS <- data_HADS %>%
  mutate(
    HADS3_t0_num = case_when(
      HADS3_t0 == "heel zeker en vrij erg" ~ 3,
      HADS3_t0 == "ja, maar niet zo erg" ~ 2,
      HADS3_t0 == "een beetje, maar ik maak me er geen zorgen over" ~ 1,
      HADS3_t0 == "helemaal niet" ~ 0
    ),
    .after = HADS3_t0
  )

# HADS-D item 4
data_HADS <- data_HADS %>%
  mutate(
    HADS4_t0_num = case_when(
      HADS4_t0 == "net zoveel als vroeger" ~ 0,
      HADS4_t0 == "nu wat minder" ~ 1,
      HADS4_t0 == "nu duidelijk minder" ~ 2,
      HADS4_t0 == "helemaal niet meer" ~ 3
    ),
    .after = HADS4_t0
  )

# HADS-A item 5
data_HADS <- data_HADS %>%
  mutate(
    HADS5_t0_num = case_when(
      HADS5_t0 == "heel erg vaak" ~ 3,
      HADS5_t0 == "vaak" ~ 2,
      HADS5_t0 == "niet zo vaak" ~ 1,
      HADS5_t0 == "heel soms" ~ 0
    ),
    .after = HADS5_t0
  )

# HADS-D item 6
data_HADS <- data_HADS %>%
  mutate(
    HADS6_t0_num = case_when(
      HADS6_t0 == "meestal" ~ 0,
      HADS6_t0 == "soms" ~ 1,
      HADS6_t0 == "niet vaak" ~ 2,
      HADS6_t0 == "helemaal niet" ~ 3
    ),
    .after = HADS6_t0
  )

# HADS-A item 7
data_HADS <- data_HADS %>%
  mutate(
    HADS7_t0_num = case_when(
      HADS7_t0 == "helemaal niet" ~ 3,
      HADS7_t0 == "niet vaak" ~ 2,
      HADS7_t0 == "meestal" ~ 1,
      HADS7_t0 == "zeker" ~ 0
    ),
    .after = HADS7_t0
  )

# HADS-D item 8
data_HADS <- data_HADS %>%
  mutate(
    HADS8_t0_num = case_when(
      HADS8_t0 == "helemaal niet" ~ 0,
      HADS8_t0 == "soms" ~ 1,
      HADS8_t0 == "heel vaak" ~ 2,
      HADS8_t0 == "bijna altijd" ~ 3
    ),
    .after = HADS8_t0
  )

# HADS-A item 9
data_HADS <- data_HADS %>%
  mutate(
    HADS9_t0_num = case_when(
      HADS9_t0 == "heel vaak" ~ 3,
      HADS9_t0 == "vrij vaak" ~ 2,
      HADS9_t0 == "soms" ~ 1,
      HADS9_t0 == "helemaal niet" ~ 0
    ),
    .after = HADS9_t0
  )

# HADS-D item 10
data_HADS <- data_HADS %>%
  mutate(
    HADS10_t0_num = case_when(
      HADS10_t0 == "evenveel interesse als voorheen" ~ 0,
      HADS10_t0 == "mogelijk wat minder" ~ 1,
      HADS10_t0 == "niet meer zoveel als ik zou moeten" ~ 2,
      HADS10_t0 == "zeker" ~ 3
    ),
    .after = HADS10_t0
  )

# HADS-A item 11
data_HADS <- data_HADS %>%
  mutate(
    HADS11_t0_num = case_when(
      HADS11_t0 == "heel erg" ~ 3,
      HADS11_t0 == "tamelijk veel" ~ 2,
      HADS11_t0 == "niet erg veel" ~ 1,
      HADS11_t0 == "helemaal niet" ~ 0
    ),
    .after = HADS11_t0
  )

# HADS-D item 12
data_HADS <- data_HADS %>%
  mutate(
    HADS12_t0_num = case_when(
      HADS12_t0 == "net zoveel als vroeger" ~ 0,
      HADS12_t0 == "een beetje minder dan vroeger" ~ 1,
      HADS12_t0 == "zeker minder dan vroeger" ~ 2,
      HADS12_t0 == "bijna nooit" ~ 3
    ),
    .after = HADS12_t0
  )

# HADS-A item 13
data_HADS <- data_HADS %>%
  mutate(
    HADS13_t0_num = case_when(
      HADS13_t0 == "zeer vaak" ~ 3,
      HADS13_t0 == "tamelijk vaak" ~ 2,
      HADS13_t0 == "niet erg vaak" ~ 1,
      HADS13_t0 == "helemaal niet" ~ 0
    ),
    .after = HADS13_t0
  )

# HADS-D item 14
data_HADS <- data_HADS %>%
  mutate(
    HADS14_t0_num = case_when(
      HADS14_t0 == "vaak" ~ 0,
      HADS14_t0 == "soms" ~ 1,
      HADS14_t0 == "niet vaak" ~ 2,
      HADS14_t0 == "heel zelden" ~ 3
    ),
    .after = HADS14_t0
  )


# Calculate HADS subscale scores -----------------------------------------

# Sum the seven anxiety items and the seven depression items separately.
data_HADS <- data_HADS %>%
  mutate(
    HADS_A_t0 = HADS1_t0_num + HADS3_t0_num + HADS5_t0_num +
      HADS7_t0_num + HADS9_t0_num + HADS11_t0_num +
      HADS13_t0_num,

    HADS_D_t0 = HADS2_t0_num + HADS4_t0_num + HADS6_t0_num +
      HADS8_t0_num + HADS10_t0_num + HADS12_t0_num +
      HADS14_t0_num
  )


# Summarise HADS scores at or above 11 -----------------------------------
# Calculate the number and percentage of participants with a HADS-A or
# HADS-D score >= 11, overall and by randomised group.

summary_table <- data_HADS %>%
  summarise(
    total_n = n(),
    n_HADS_A_11plus = sum(HADS_A_t0 >= 11, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_HADS_D_11plus = sum(HADS_D_t0 >= 11, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_HADS_A_11plus = 100 * n_HADS_A_11plus / total_n,
    pct_HADS_D_11plus = 100 * n_HADS_D_11plus / total_n
  )

summary_table


# Repeat the summary by randomised group
summary_by_arm <- data_HADS %>%
  group_by(arm) %>%
  summarise(
    total_n = n(),
    n_HADS_A_11plus = sum(HADS_A_t0 >= 11, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_HADS_D_11plus = sum(HADS_D_t0 >= 11, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_HADS_A_11plus = 100 * n_HADS_A_11plus / total_n,
    pct_HADS_D_11plus = 100 * n_HADS_D_11plus / total_n
  )

summary_by_arm
```
